trigger: I think my rights were violated
description: Steps to take if a government official, the police, or an institution has breached your fundamental rights.

steps.text: Get to safety first. Deal with any urgent medical needs and, if you were injured, get a medical report.
Write down exactly what happened: date, time, place, who was involved, and what was said or done.
Collect evidence - documents, photographs, messages, and the names and contacts of any witnesses.
You can apply to a High Court in your State for redress. Any breach of a Chapter IV right can be taken there (s.46(1)).
Contact a lawyer to file a Fundamental Rights Enforcement application on your behalf.
If you cannot afford a lawyer, call the Legal Aid Council.
You can also report the violation to the National Human Rights Commission.
